text:
Not entirely confirmed. For 5 October to 3 November 2026, no fire detections from any of the four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS) intersected the asset. However, the final day of the period, 3 to 4 November, was not covered by any sensor. The data had not yet been published for that day, or it was still in progress.

Under the run's own rule, every day must be covered by each sensor to count as covered, so the period does not meet that standard. The accurate statement is: no fires were detected through 3 November, and the last day is unverified. Re-running once the data for 3 to 4 November is published would confirm the full period.

Also, these are satellite thermal detections, so very small or brief fires could be missed. The asset's area was not recorded in this run.
